texts.li: Over a bowl of soup, {X_nameDef} told {A_nameDef} that two warlords up north are burning each other's fields again. Grain will be dear by winter.
A town three weeks east has the coughing sickness, {X_nameDef} told {A_nameDef}, and they've started nailing the doors shut on the sick.
{A_nameDef} heard from {X_nameDef} that salt costs twice what it did last year, and that the bridge at the ford has washed out.
{A_nameDef} sat up with {X_nameDef} hearing who is at war, who is starving and who got hanged since the last caravan came through.
There's a one-eyed swordswoman down south who has fought forty duels and lost none, according to {X_nameDef}. {A_nameDef} wanted to know how she held her blade, and where she stood.
{X_nameDef} once watched a duelist called the Heron cut a candle in half without tipping it over. {A_nameDef} spent the evening trying it with a kitchen knife and went through a dozen candles.
{A_nameDef} had {X_nameDef} describe a famous swordsman's footwork three times over, then practiced it in the yard until dark.
{X_nameDef} showed {A_nameDef} how {FACTION} cooks stretch a stew over four days with salt and onion, and {A_nameDef} traded a trick for rice that doesn't stick.
{A_nameDef} and {X_nameDef} argued all afternoon about whether berries belong in a meat pie. They settled it by baking one of each and eating both.
{X_nameDef} swears by a pinch of ash in the bread. {A_nameDef} tried it, made a face, and then baked a second batch the same way.
{A_nameDef} traded {X_nameDef} a pemmican recipe for one that makes old muffalo chewable. Each of them is sure they got the better deal.
{X_nameDef} ran a hand along a wall {A_nameDef} had built and asked who laid it. {A_nameDef} admitted it was {A_objective}, and showed {X_objective} how the corners were tied in.
{X_nameDef} said the colony's walls were straighter than any {X_pronoun} had seen this side of the mountains, and {A_nameDef} went red to the ears.
{X_nameDef} rapped a knuckle on a doorframe {A_nameDef} had hung, listened, and nodded.
{X_nameDef} stood in front of {A_nameDef}'s carving for a long while, then asked what it was. {A_nameDef} told {X_objective} about the person it was made for.
{X_nameDef} asked {A_nameDef} what the carving by the door would cost. It wasn't for sale, but {A_nameDef} was pleased all evening to have been asked.
{X_nameDef} went still in front of {A_nameDef}'s work, wiped {X_possessive} eyes, and wouldn't say why.
{A_nameDef} and {X_nameDef} played raiders and colonists behind the barn until they were called in for supper.
{X_nameDef} taught {A_nameDef} a clapping song from the road, with a verse the grown-ups wouldn't like.
{A_nameDef} and {X_nameDef} caught a frog, named it, lost it, and held a funeral for it by the well.
{A_nameDef} showed {X_nameDef} every hiding spot in the colony, and they took turns in each of them until dark.
{X_nameDef} sang a long song about a miller's daughter and a bear, and {A_nameDef} asked for it again from the start.
{X_nameDef} told ghost stories by the fire until {A_nameDef} jumped at a settling log. {X_nameDef} called it the best reaction yet and told another one.
{X_nameDef} knew a drinking song with forty verses. {A_nameDef} had the chorus by the fifth and was bellowing it by the twentieth.
{X_nameDef} told how {X_possessive} caravan once crossed a frozen lake and lost two muffalo through the ice, and {A_nameDef} sat forward the whole time.
According to {X_nameDef}, {A_nameDef} has kind eyes for someone carrying that many knives. {A_nameDef} didn't know where to look.
{A_nameDef} offered to show {X_nameDef} the view from the wall, and they were up there until well after dark.
{X_nameDef} laughed at every one of {A_nameDef}'s jokes, even the old one about the boomalope.
{A_nameDef} and {X_nameDef} shared a bench and a jug of beer, and sat closer than the bench required. The caravan leaves tomorrow.
{X_nameDef} called the colony "a mud fort with opinions", and {A_nameDef} had to be walked away from the gate.
{X_nameDef} said a settlement this small ought to pay {FACTION} for protection. {A_nameDef} said a great many things back, several of them about {X_nameDef}'s mother.
{A_nameDef} and {X_nameDef} argued about how strangers ought to be treated, loudly, at the gate, with other strangers listening.
{X_nameDef} squinted at {A_nameDef} and asked, "You're that one, aren't you? From the stories?" {A_nameDef} didn't know which stories {X_pronoun} meant.
{X_nameDef} said people on the road talk about {A_nameDef}, and not all of it is lies. {A_nameDef} spent dinner trying to find out which parts.
{X_nameDef} asked to touch {A_nameDef}'s sleeve for luck, and explained that there's a song going round the camps with {A_nameDef} in the second verse.
{A_nameDef} carried water for {X_nameDef}'s lame pack animal without being asked. Later, {X_nameDef} pressed some coins and a sprig of healroot into {A_possessive} hand and wouldn't take them back.
{A_nameDef} gave up {A_possessive} seat by the fire for {X_nameDef}, and on the way out {X_nameDef} handed {A_objective} a bundle with silver and healing herbs in it.
{A_nameDef} mended a torn strap on {X_nameDef}'s pack, and {X_nameDef} insisted on paying for it in silver and healroot.
{A_nameDef} and {X_nameDef} compared scars over a jug of beer. {X_nameDef} won with an arrowhead still lodged in {X_possessive} shoulder, and let {A_nameDef} feel it.
{X_nameDef} showed {A_nameDef} how {FACTION} spearmen brace for a charge. {A_nameDef} showed {X_nameDef} where to hit someone who's bracing like that.
{A_nameDef} and {X_nameDef} didn't say much about the fighting itself. They named the people they'd lost and drank to each one.
{X_nameDef} has fought in three border wars, and {A_nameDef} has fought everything that came over the colony's walls. They talked tactics until the fire burned down.
{X_nameDef} stared at {A_nameDef} all day, from the gate, from the well and across the supper table, and only said "what?" when {A_nameDef} asked about it.
{X_nameDef} watched {A_nameDef} chop wood for an hour without a word, then spat and walked off. {A_nameDef} has been going over every swing since.
Wherever {A_nameDef} went today, {X_nameDef} was leaning on a wall nearby, watching. In the evening {X_nameDef} explained that {A_nameDef} looks very like {X_possessive} dead brother.
{X_nameDef}'s dog followed {A_nameDef} around all afternoon and leaned on {A_possessive} legs whenever {A_pronoun} stopped. {X_nameDef} said it only does that with people it likes.
{X_nameDef}'s scruffy dog stole a sausage off {A_nameDef}'s plate and ate it looking {A_objective} in the eye, and {A_nameDef} gave it the crust as well.
{A_nameDef} spent the afternoon picking burrs out of {X_nameDef}'s dog, a shaggy old thing called Captain.
{X_nameDef} taught {A_nameDef} a dice game called Muffalo Knees and won every round, though {A_nameDef} was catching on by the end.
{A_nameDef} and {X_nameDef} played knucklebones for pebbles all evening, and {A_nameDef} went to bed with forty of them.
{X_nameDef} lost three rounds of dice to {A_nameDef} and blamed the dice, so they played on with {X_possessive} own set until the candle burned out.
{A_nameDef} talked {X_nameDef} down on a bolt of cloth until the trader threw up {X_possessive} hands and called {A_objective} a bandit.
{A_nameDef} pointed out a moth hole and a crooked seam in the coat, and {X_nameDef} knocked a third off the price.
{X_nameDef} asked forty silver, {A_nameDef} laughed, and after a long hour they settled at twenty-two.
{A_nameDef} haggled {X_nameDef} down from twenty silver to eighteen and walked off proud. Then {A_nameDef} watched someone else buy the same thing for nine.
{X_nameDef} talked {A_nameDef} into a copper pot with a crack in the bottom, which {A_nameDef} found the first time {A_pronoun} filled it.
{A_nameDef} tried walking away from the deal, and {X_nameDef} let {A_objective} go. {A_nameDef} came back a few minutes later and paid full price.
Far to the south, {X_nameDef} said, there is a coast where the sea stays warm in winter and fish jump into the boats. {A_nameDef} asked how many days' travel it was.
{X_nameDef} has seen a city with walls taller than trees and a market that never closes, and described every street of it to {A_nameDef}.
{X_nameDef} described salt flats white as bone, under skies so clear you can count every star. That night {A_nameDef} sat out late looking at the sky over the colony.
The cask of beer {A_nameDef} bought from {X_nameDef} turned out to be half river water, and {X_nameDef} claimed to know nothing about it.
{X_nameDef}'s scales were off by a thumb's weight, and {A_nameDef} only noticed after the trade was done, three days' hauling short.
The leather boots {A_nameDef} bought from {X_nameDef} came apart at the first puddle. The soles had been stuck on with pitch.
{X_nameDef} turned a knife over in {X_possessive} hands and asked if {A_nameDef} made it. {X_nameDef} sold one just like it last year, to a captain who wouldn't stop bragging about it.
{X_nameDef} recognized {A_nameDef}'s stitching on a colonist's coat and said coats like that fetch a good price two towns over.
{X_nameDef} asked who made the colony's tools. When {A_nameDef} said it was {A_objective}, {X_nameDef} asked if {A_pronoun} had ever thought of leaving. {A_nameDef} said no.
While they traded, {X_nameDef} passed on to {A_nameDef} the story of a settlement east of here that tried to rope a thrumbo and lost most of its fences doing it.
{X_nameDef} has been to every settlement within a week's ride, and knows which ones are broke, which are feuding and which still pay fair.
According to {X_nameDef}, the last colony {X_pronoun} visited paid in turnips and insults. {A_nameDef} took the hint and was very polite all afternoon.
{X_nameDef} let {A_nameDef} try a pinch of the spice {X_pronoun} was selling, and {A_nameDef} spent supper trying to describe the taste.
{X_nameDef} cut {A_nameDef} a sliver of hard cheese from three weeks south, and {A_nameDef} made it last as long as {A_pronoun} could.
{X_nameDef} poured {A_nameDef} a thimble of amber liquor from a stoppered flask. {A_nameDef} coughed until {A_possessive} eyes ran, then held out the thimble again.
{A_nameDef} held up {X_nameDef}'s best cloak and asked how much {X_nameDef} would pay {A_objective} to take it away.
{A_nameDef} sniffed {X_nameDef}'s dried meat and announced that the animal had died of old age. {X_nameDef} packed it away and didn't offer {A_nameDef} anything else.
{A_nameDef} told {X_nameDef}, loudly, that {FACTION} prices are the reason there are bandits on the roads.
{X_nameDef} sent {A_nameDef} back to the kitchen twice, once because the soup was cold and once because it was too hot, then tipped {A_objective} eight silver for the trouble.
{X_nameDef} asked {A_nameDef} where the bath was, and when {A_nameDef} pointed at the river, {X_nameDef} complained about it for the rest of the day.
{X_nameDef} had {A_nameDef} turn the mattress three times and shake out the blankets twice before the bed was fit to lie in.
{X_nameDef} called {A_nameDef} "you there" all day and never once asked {A_possessive} name.
{X_nameDef} watched {A_nameDef} settle a quarrel at dinner and said it was better done than in half the courts {X_pronoun} had sat in, then showed {A_objective} how to bow properly.
{X_nameDef} spent an evening teaching {A_nameDef} which fork is for what at a lord's table, and {A_nameDef} paid close attention, though the colony owns only the one kind.
{X_nameDef} told {A_nameDef} {A_pronoun} had the bearing of someone born to a better house, and that it was a shame about the clothes.
{X_nameDef} hadn't said ten words since arriving. Today {A_nameDef} brought {X_objective} a second bowl of stew without asking, and {X_nameDef} cried into it and said thank you, over and over.
{X_nameDef} told {A_nameDef} it was the first night in a month {X_pronoun} hadn't slept with {X_possessive} shoes on. {A_nameDef} didn't know what to say, and just nodded.
{X_nameDef} carved {A_nameDef} a small wooden bird with a borrowed knife, badly, and handed it over with both hands. "For the blanket," {X_nameDef} said.
{X_nameDef} got bored of being protected and felled a dead tree out back before {A_nameDef} noticed. "Beats sitting around waiting to be murdered," {X_nameDef} said.
{X_nameDef} insisted on helping {A_nameDef} cut and haul logs, and once {A_nameDef} had shown {X_objective} how to hold the axe, {X_pronoun} kept up all afternoon.
{A_nameDef} came back to find that {X_nameDef} had chopped a fallen trunk into logs and stacked them by size against the wall.
{X_nameDef} woke {A_nameDef} at midnight to ask whether the gate was barred. It was. {X_nameDef} went to check anyway, and {A_nameDef} went too.
{X_nameDef} sat up all night facing the door with a kitchen knife in {X_possessive} lap, and {A_nameDef} sat up with {X_objective}.
In a low voice, {X_nameDef} told {A_nameDef} what the people hunting {X_objective} do to anyone who helps. Then {X_nameDef} thanked {A_objective} for the bed.
{A_nameDef} sat outside {X_nameDef}'s cell after supper and talked about the weather, the beans and a dog {A_pronoun} once had, until {X_nameDef} started talking back.
{A_nameDef} slid an extra blanket under {X_nameDef}'s door and said goodnight. {X_nameDef} didn't answer, but the blanket was gone by morning.
{X_nameDef} asked {A_nameDef} why {A_pronoun} bothered being kind to a prisoner. {A_nameDef} shrugged and passed {X_objective} the rest of {A_possessive} bread.
Through the bars, {X_nameDef} said {X_possessive} friends know where the wall is thin, and {A_nameDef} walked the whole wall twice before supper.
{X_nameDef} spent the whole meal describing how {X_pronoun} would have burned the colony down, building by building. {A_nameDef} left half {A_possessive} dinner.
Every time {A_nameDef} walked past the cell, {X_nameDef} counted out loud, one number higher than the time before. {A_nameDef} has started taking the long way round.
{X_nameDef} told {A_nameDef} how {X_pronoun} ended up raiding, by way of a burned farm, a debt and a cousin with a plan.
{X_nameDef} has a daughter somewhere south who thinks {X_nameDef} is a trader. {X_nameDef} asked {A_nameDef} not to tell her, if she ever came by. {A_nameDef} promised.
Through the door, {X_nameDef} described the last meal {X_pronoun} ate at home, down to the burnt crust. {A_nameDef} stayed to listen long after the bowl was collected.
{A_nameDef} and {X_nameDef} worked out they grew up two valleys apart, on the same bad bread and the same tax collectors. They talked through the bars until the candle died.
{X_nameDef} hummed a work song in the cell, and {A_nameDef} sang the next line without thinking. They had worked the same mines, years apart.
{A_nameDef} and {X_nameDef} both ran away from home at twelve and slept in stables, and they swapped stories about it through the door until the watch changed.

ColonyCouncil.EncounterDef.label: face to face through the bars

texts.li: {A_nameDef} stood at {X_nameDef}'s door for a long time without a word. {X_nameDef} looked up, recognized {A_objective}, and looked away first.
{X_nameDef} grinned at {A_nameDef} through the bars and asked how the scar was coming along. {A_nameDef} walked away before {A_possessive} hands could decide anything.
{A_nameDef} carried {X_nameDef}'s dinner in personally, set it down, and said, "Now I know where you sleep, too."
The last time they met, {A_nameDef} was on the ground and {X_nameDef} was standing over {A_objective}. Today {X_nameDef} is on a cell floor, and {A_nameDef} can't stop looking.
{X_nameDef} sent word to {A_nameDef} that the rats in the cell eat better than {X_pronoun} does.
The food, {X_nameDef} told {A_nameDef}, was the worst part of being captured, worse than the wound.
With {X_possessive} mouth full, {X_nameDef} asked {A_nameDef} whether {A_pronoun} had ever cooked before or was just guessing.
{X_nameDef} offered {A_nameDef} a map to a buried chest of silver in exchange for one unlocked door, and drew it on the cell floor in porridge.
{X_nameDef} whispered to {A_nameDef} that {X_possessive} people pay well for friends on the inside, and named a sum of silver too large to believe.
{X_nameDef} promised {A_nameDef} a horse, a sword and a cousin's hand in marriage in exchange for the key.
{X_nameDef} caught {A_nameDef}'s ankle from the dirt and begged, over and over, not to be left out there for the wolves.
Bleeding in the mud, {X_nameDef} recognized {A_nameDef} from a trade two seasons back and begged {A_objective} by name.
{X_nameDef} promised {A_nameDef} silver, {X_possessive} boots, never coming back, anything at all, and was still promising when {A_nameDef} walked away.
{X_nameDef} couldn't stand, but could still talk, and cursed {A_nameDef}'s mother, face and colony until {X_possessive} voice gave out.
{X_nameDef} spat blood at {A_nameDef}'s boots and swore {X_possessive} brothers would come for {A_objective}, then named every one of them.
{X_nameDef} lay in the mud cursing {A_nameDef} in a language {A_nameDef} didn't know, and kept at it until {A_nameDef} had gone.
{X_nameDef} asked for water, just that. {A_nameDef} knelt and held the waterskin while {X_nameDef} drank, and neither of them mentioned the fight.
{A_nameDef} gave {X_nameDef} a drink and wiped the dirt off {X_possessive} face. {X_nameDef} said {X_possessive} mother used to do that.
{X_nameDef} was trying to lick rainwater off a stone. {A_nameDef} swore under {A_possessive} breath and went to fetch a cup.
{X_nameDef} lay on {X_possessive} back praying, the same short line over and over, until {A_nameDef} realized {A_pronoun} had learned the words.
{X_nameDef} was praying to a god with a great many teeth, by the sound of it. {A_nameDef} hurried past and felt watched for the rest of the day.
{X_nameDef} asked {A_nameDef} to pray with {X_objective}. {A_nameDef} didn't know the god or the words, but knelt in the mud for a minute anyway.
{X_nameDef} grabbed {A_nameDef}'s sleeve and made {A_objective} repeat a name twice, Tamsin, at the mill by the black river, and promise to tell her it wasn't her fault.
{X_nameDef} told {A_nameDef} where {X_pronoun} had buried {X_possessive} mother's knife, so that somebody would know.
Between gasps, {X_nameDef} asked {A_nameDef} to tell the others {X_pronoun} hadn't run. {A_nameDef} promised, without knowing who the others were.
{A_nameDef} stopped over the downed {X_nameDef}, spat in the dirt an inch from {X_possessive} face, and walked off whistling.
{A_nameDef} crouched by {X_nameDef} and explained, in some detail, how the fight could have gone even worse for {X_objective}. Then {A_nameDef} spat, smiled, and left.
{X_nameDef} asked {A_nameDef} for help. {A_nameDef} spat on {X_objective} and said that was all the help on offer today. A few people saw.
{X_nameDef} was sure this was the end and gave {A_nameDef} a long, trembling speech about {X_possessive} regrets, over what turned out to be a sprained ankle.
{X_nameDef} forgave {A_nameDef}, forgave the world, and asked {A_objective} to sing {X_objective} out. {A_nameDef} pointed out that the wound was mostly bruise.
{X_nameDef} said goodbye to {A_nameDef}, to the sky and to someone called Bram, then fell asleep and snored.
